entries.name: Aider
entries.summary: Terminal pair programming with codebase maps, Git integration and support for cloud or local models.
entries.use_case: Make a focused change in an existing repository and review it with familiar Git tools.

entries.name: Claude Code
entries.summary: Anthropic's coding agent for terminal, IDE, desktop and web workflows, with file editing, commands and tool integrations.
entries.use_case: Investigate a codebase and implement a scoped change using a supported subscription, Console account or provider.

entries.name: Cline
entries.summary: Coding agent for VS Code and the terminal, with reviewable edits, command execution and MCP tools.
entries.use_case: Work through a code change in your editor, inspecting the agent's edits and actions.

entries.name: Cursor
entries.summary: An editor-based coding agent with codebase search, file editing and terminal tools, backed by Cursor's services.
entries.use_case: Iterate on a multi-file change in the editor and review the resulting diff; account and usage terms apply.

entries.name: Devin
entries.summary: Cognition's hosted coding agent, with a development workspace for writing, running and testing code.
entries.use_case: Delegate a scoped repository task through a Devin account, then inspect its draft changes and tests.

entries.name: Gemini CLI
entries.summary: An open-source terminal agent from Google with file and shell tools, search grounding and MCP integrations.
entries.use_case: Explore and change a repository from the command line; Gemini account or API access has separate terms and limits.

entries.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
entries.summary: A terminal coding agent with GitHub context, file changes, shell tools and interactive or scripted sessions.
entries.use_case: Work on code and pull requests from your terminal; Copilot plans and model providers have separate conditions.

entries.name: goose
entries.summary: An extensible agent for coding and everyday workflows, available as a desktop app, CLI and API.
entries.use_case: Connect tools through MCP and work through development, research or data tasks on your machine.

entries.name: OpenAI Codex
entries.summary: OpenAI's coding agent across terminal, IDE and cloud, with repository inspection, file edits and command execution.
entries.use_case: Develop a repository change locally or in a configured cloud environment, then review the patch and tests.

entries.name: OpenCode
entries.summary: A coding agent with a terminal interface and separate modes for planning and making changes.
entries.use_case: Explore an unfamiliar repository in plan mode, then switch to implementing a change.

entries.name: OpenHands
entries.summary: Agent Canvas provides a self-hosted control center for coding agents across local, container and remote backends.
entries.use_case: Manage coding conversations and repeatable automations from one developer interface.

entries.name: Qwen Code
entries.summary: A terminal coding agent from the Qwen team, with multiple model-provider APIs, subagents and MCP support.
entries.use_case: Run an interactive coding session or a headless task using a compatible hosted or local model.

entries.name: CrewAI
entries.summary: A Python framework combining agents with defined roles and event-driven workflows through Crews and Flows.
entries.use_case: Build a workflow where specialized agents research, draft and review a result in defined stages.

entries.name: Google Agent Development Kit
entries.summary: A code-first framework for building, evaluating and deploying agents, with workflow orchestration and multiple model options.
entries.use_case: Compose agents and tools into a testable workflow; choose the model provider and deployment environment yourself.

entries.name: LangGraph
entries.summary: Infrastructure for stateful agent workflows, with persistence, resumable execution and human review points.
entries.use_case: Build a multi-step agent that can pause for a decision and resume from saved state.

entries.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
entries.summary: A framework for agents and graph-based workflows in Python and .NET, with provider integrations and observability.
entries.use_case: Build a multi-stage application with state, tool access and review steps across Python or .NET services.

entries.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
entries.summary: An SDK for agent applications with tools, handoffs, guardrails, session state and tracing; Python and TypeScript implementations.
entries.use_case: Build a specialist workflow with explicit tools and review points; configure model access separately.

entries.name: Pydantic AI
entries.summary: A Python SDK for typed agent applications, with validated structured outputs, tool definitions and multiple model providers.
entries.use_case: Turn a model-assisted workflow into typed application data and test its tools and output contracts.

entries.name: smolagents
entries.summary: A compact Python agent library from Hugging Face, including agents that express tool actions as executable code.
entries.use_case: Prototype an agent with a small set of tools and choose an appropriate execution sandbox.

entries.name: llama.cpp
entries.summary: A C/C++ inference engine with quantized models and a range of CPU and GPU backends.
entries.use_case: Run a compatible model on your own hardware and tune the inference setup to fit its resources.

entries.name: LM Studio
entries.summary: A desktop application for downloading, running and managing local models, with chat, MCP tools and local HTTP APIs.
entries.use_case: Load a compatible model on your hardware and connect an application through its documented API; model licenses are separate.

entries.name: Ollama
entries.summary: A model runtime with a CLI, model management and an HTTP API for connecting applications to language models.
entries.use_case: Serve a compatible model locally and connect an agent or application to its API.

entries.name: Agent Client Protocol
entries.summary: A protocol connecting code editors and coding agents, with message schemas and SDKs for client and agent implementations.
entries.use_case: Connect a coding agent to a compatible editor without building a separate integration for every pair.

entries.name: Agent2Agent
entries.summary: An open protocol for independent agent applications to discover capabilities and collaborate across systems.
entries.use_case: Connect agents built with different frameworks without exposing all of their internal tools or state.

entries.name: Model Context Protocol
entries.summary: An open standard for connecting AI applications to external tools, data sources and workflows.
entries.use_case: Expose a tool or data source through a shared client-server interface that compatible agents can use.
